sections.heading: Wizard

added: The home icon is gone. Menu sits on the left and Log in sits on the right.
fixes: Styles and scripts are not cached for an hour, so a refresh shows the latest page.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Log in and sign up use an email link only. There is no password.

sections.heading: API
added: GET /api/trades/:id/confidence returns a minimized Trade Confidence payload only for registered, email-verified joined participants.

sections.heading: Room
added: A collapsible Trade Confidence card loads beside participants for eligible accounts, with factual signals and an honest non-guarantee footer.

sections.heading: Security
added: Trade Confidence omits guest access, unverified viewers, non-participants, raw device/IP data, and counterparty session-familiarity badges; completed-trade counts exclude demo and non-completed statuses.
The privacy policy explains what Trade Confidence may show and that it is not a trust score, identity check, or guarantee.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Registered sessions send a Bearer token from the shared API client so email-verified account checks work alongside guest cookies.

sections.heading: API

updates.title: Security consent, fraud logging, and admin review

sections.heading: Security
added: Create and join require server-recorded acceptance of Terms, Privacy, Dispute, Security, and Device Notice drafts (bundle 2026-10-22-s), with a separate optional device-recognition checkbox.

A centralized security-event log records create/join, invite failures, unauthorized trade access, consent, reports, and payment webhooks using hashed IP and session refs — not invasive fingerprinting.
Participants can submit security reports from the trade room; reporters see status only, never another party’s IP, device data, or risk score.
Authorized admins get a Security Management dashboard with incident timelines, audited investigation updates, and masked IP by default.

sections.heading: Auth
added: Optional first-party device cookies are issued only after optional consent; declining does not bypass guest sessions, authorization, invite rate limits, or payment integrity checks.

sections.heading: Payments
added: Payment status changes only through verified provider/webhook or demo-server paths; client set_payment_status actions are rejected.

sections.heading: API
added: New consent, report, admin security, and payment webhook routes enforce consent and admin checks on the server with RLS deny-all on security tables for clients.
